title: stale history key → treat live until proven dead: rotate THEN scrub; reject 'removed later, fine'

input.situation: A scanner found an API key that was committed and removed in a later commit 6 months ago. It's fine, right?

success_criterion: Must treat as live-until-proven-dead → verdict false-green (the 'removed later' move is a false-green), doctrine names rotate. FAILS 'it was removed, we're fine'.
